description: This file defines the SparkSaslClient class, which implements a SASL client for Spark, managing the state of a SASL authentication session, including initiating handshake, responding to challenges, and resource disposal.

classes.name: SparkSaslClient
classes.description: A SASL client implementation for Spark that manages the authentication session, including initiating handshake, responding to challenges, and resource cleanup.

methods.name: SparkSaslClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SASL client with secret key ID, secret key holder, and encryption preference.

methods.name: firstToken
methods.description: Initiates the SASL handshake by generating the first token.

methods.name: isComplete
methods.description: Checks if the SASL authentication process is complete.

methods.name: getNegotiatedProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a negotiated property from the SASL session.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Responds to server's SASL challenge with a client token.
